description:
Verify a receipt online

Checks a creator store receipt's signature and returns what it records (the item, quantity, wallet, amount paid, when) with its current status. A refunded order's receipt reads `revoked`: offline verification proves a receipt was issued, this proves it still stands. The receipt is the compact JWS exactly as issued (three base64url parts joined by dots).

The answer is `200` whatever the receipt is. Act on `valid`, which is true only for status `valid`. A string that is not a receipt Chain Daddy signed (a bad signature, a changed payload, an unknown key, not a JWS at all) answers `{"valid": false, "status": "invalid", "error": "…"}` with no `payload`.
name: verify_receipt

error.description: Why the receipt is `invalid`. Absent otherwise

payload.description: The receipt's decoded claims. Absent when `status` is `invalid`

appId.description: Present only on an order made through an app, the app

appItem.description: Present only on an app's own item, the app's key for it

currency.description: What the buyer actually paid in (the store token, the chain's coin or the dollar stable)

kind.description: Present only on an order made through an app

priceUsdMicros.description: Present only on a dollar-priced order, per unit

usdPerToken.description: Present only on a dollar-priced order, the USD price of one whole unit of `currency` the quote used

status.description:
`valid`: the receipt is ours and its order stands. `revoked`: a refund was recorded since.
`invalid`: not a receipt Chain Daddy signed; `error` says why and there is no `payload`.
`unknown`: the signature is ours, but this API has no record of the receipt.

valid.description: True only when `status` is `valid`. Deliver on this

title: Verify a store receipt
